label: Sentinel-2 true colour, 2025-09-23
credit: Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data 2025, processed by ESA; Sentinel-2 L2A COGs from AWS Open Data (Element 84)
rights: Copernicus Sentinel data: free, full and open access under the Copernicus data policy (Commission Delegated Regulation (EU) No 1159/2013); attribution required
source: Sentinel-2 L2A TCI (B04, B03, B02), Cloud-Optimized GeoTIFFs

image.crs: EPSG:26910 frame; imagery WGS84 / UTM 10N, datum difference (~1 m) ignored
image.resampling: nearest overview pixel at each cell centre

limits: One summer acquisition: shadows and colours are that day's; 8-bit TCI stretch as delivered by ESA; clouds in the scene (see cloud_cover_percent) are not masked.
